description:
Manage Focus projects with the following actions:

- **create-project**: Create a project with related data such as members, milestones, rates, and billable rates. Follow the create action's privacy and billable guidance. Project fields go under payload.project. Set rates through payload.billable_rates, not the legacy payload.rates (start_at/end_at). For payload.billable_rates: hourly_rate is in the currency's smallest unit, so it depends on the currency: two-decimal currencies like USD/EUR use cents (5000 = 50.00), zero-decimal ones like JPY/KRW use whole units (5000 = 5000), three-decimal ones like KWD/BHD use thousandths. Reads return the same unit. Omit end_date for an open-ended schedule; when set it must be on or after start_date. (data: payload*{project*, billable_rates, members, milestones, rates})
- **add-project-members** (data: payload*{role_id*, group_ids, user_ids}, project_id*)
- **archive** (data: project_id*)
- **attachments-bulk-create**: Uploads several local files in one call. names and display_orders are optional parallel arrays; they default to the file basenames and array positions. (data: project_id*, file_paths*, names, display_orders)
- **attachments-create**: Uploads a local file (file_path) as an attachment. The mime type is inferred from the extension and the API rejects disallowed types; uploads are capped at 20 MB. (data: project_id*, file_path*, name, display_order)
- **attachments-delete** (data: attachment_id*, project_id*)
- **attachments-list**: Lists attachment metadata. Upload files with attachments-create (file_path), download with attachments-view (save_to). (data: order_by, project_id*)
- **attachments-update**: Full update (PUT): both name and display_order are required; the response body is empty, verify via attachments-list. (data: attachment_id*, payload*{display_order*, name*}, project_id*)
- **attachments-view**: Downloads the attachment's binary content to a local path (save_to). Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true. (data: project_id*, attachment_id*, save_to*, overwrite)
- **bulk-archive** (data: project_ids*)
- **bulk-delete**: Deletes all listed project IDs in one HTTP call. (data: ids*)
- **bulk-patch**: Prefer over many project updates: JSON array of { id: projectId, ...partial fields } matching single-project patch fields. (data: array payload)
- **bulk-restore** (data: project_ids*)
- **bulk-unarchive** (data: project_ids*)
- **complete** (data: project_id*)
- **create**: Required: name. Recommended: color (hex). The API defaults private and billable to false when omitted. Match the Toggl UI on privacy. If the user explicitly asks for a shared or public project, pass private=false; no permissions check is needed, because only private projects require an entitlement. Otherwise call workspace-settings get-user-permissions and pass private=true when permissions includes access_private_projects_tasks_feature. If that permission is absent, pass private=false and tell the user; if the user explicitly required a private project, do not create a shared one. Leave billable unset unless the user explicitly says the work is billable or provides a rate. Associate with a client via client_id. (data: name*, auto_compute_estimates, auto_start_on, billable, client_id, color, completion_mode, custom_fields, description, draft, end_date, estimate_source, estimated_mins, fixed_fee{amount*, currency*}, is_template, parent_project_id, pinned, private, rollover_mode, rrule, start_date, tag_ids)
- **create-from-template** (data: payload*{auto_compute_estimates, completion_mode, end_date, estimate_source, name, pinned, rollover_mode, rrule, start_date}, project_id*)
- **create-recurring-project-instance** (data: date*, payload*{billable, estimate_source, private}, project_id*)
- **create-template-from** (data: payload*{auto_compute_estimates, estimate_source, estimated_mins, fixed_fee, name, rrule}, project_id*)
- **delete**: Permanently deletes the project and disassociates its tasks. (data: project_id*)
- **duplicate** (data: payload*{name}, project_id*)
- **duplicate-template** (data: payload*{name}, project_id*)
- **get**: Fetch a single project with aggregated task counts and time estimates. (data: project_id*)
- **get-batch-projects-members** (data: ids*)
- **get-members** (data: project_id*)
- **get-recurring-project-instance** (data: date*, project_id*)
- **get-recurring-project-instances** (data: end_date, include_rollover, order_by, page, per_page, project_id*, start_date)
- **get-templates** (data: archived, name, order_by, page, per_page)
- **get-with-children** (data: order_by, page, per_page, project_id*)
- **get-with-parents** (data: order_by, page, per_page, project_id*)
- **groups-get** (data: archived, cf_filter, client_id, completed, creator_id, end_date, group*, include_drafts, include_group_totals, include_recurring_series, include_unassigned, name, only_me, order_by, page, parent_project_id, per_page, private, project_id, project_order_by, projects_per_group, start_date, tag_id, user_id)
- **list**: Use user_id to filter to projects that include a specific member. Filter by pinned=true for starred projects. (data: name, pinned, user_id, client_id, page, per_page)
- **make-project-public** (data: project_id*)
- **margin-targets-clear** (data: project_id*)
- **margin-targets-get** (data: project_id*)
- **margin-targets-get-workspace** (data: none)
- **margin-targets-list** (data: none)
- **margin-targets-set** (data: payload*{target_percent*}, project_id*)
- **margin-targets-set-workspace** (data: payload*{target_percent*})
- **pin** (data: project_id*)
- **remove-project-member** (data: payload*{group_id, user_id}, project_id*)
- **restore** (data: project_id*)
- **unarchive** (data: project_id*)
- **uncomplete** (data: project_id*)
- **unpin** (data: project_id*)
- **update**: Partial update — provide project_id and only the fields to change under payload. custom_fields writes values as a map keyed by custom field ID; reads return the same data as custom_field_values[], so the write shape is not the read shape. (data: project_id*, payload*{...})
- **full-update** (data: payload*{...}, project_id*)
- **update-member-role** (data: payload*{role_id*, group_id, user_id}, project_id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.
